SelenEkto application logo

Place YOUR PNG at this exact relative path:

    assets/branding/logo.png

Use a square PNG (512x512 or 1024x1024 recommended), preferably with
transparent background. Existing SelenEkto 2.0 app will show it at the
upper-left corner and use it as the window icon if present. The image is
optional: when it isn't present, SelenEkto opens normally with text branding.

This file documents the drop location. Do not rename your image to logo.png.png.
